prompt: What is the reference angle for $225^\circ$? Give just the number of degrees.
hint: $225^\circ$ is in Quadrant III, past the $180^\circ$ mark.

hints.text: $225^\circ$ is in Quadrant III, past the $180^\circ$ mark.
In Quadrant III the reference angle is the angle minus $180^\circ$.

explanation: $225^\circ$ lands in Quadrant III, between $180^\circ$ and $270^\circ$.
The nearest part of the $x$-axis is the $180^\circ$ direction, so measure from there: $225^\circ - 180^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Straight down the diagonal
steps: $225^\circ$ points exactly into the corner of Quadrant III, equally far left and down.
That diagonal makes a $45^\circ$ angle with the horizontal axis, so the reference angle is $45^\circ$.
